By Anuj Sengar, Licensed RCIC R515178 · Founder, Can X GlobalPublished: March 2026 · 5 min read You came to Canada because your employer sponsored you. Maybe they paid for the LMIA, supported your application, and helped get you here. But now things have changed. Maybe the job is not what you expected. Maybe you have a better offer. Maybe the relationship just is not working. You are wondering: am I legally stuck with this employer?
